shared_elements: multiple horizontal ruled registers of small repeated signs (script)
group of standing human figures side by side
figures rendered at larger scale than the signs
sculptural/relief figures set within a framed monument field
justification: Both show a single large framed monument combining a group of standing human figures at one end with an extensive field of tightly stacked horizontal lines of small script signs, a fairly specific combination of figural scene plus long text block. The differences are that B preserves an explicit scene (a rayed disc above two adoring figures flanked by smaller attendants and an offering table, plus cartouche panels) whereas in A only a row of eroded standing statues below the text lines is legible, with no visible disc, offering table or hierarchical grouping.
